clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, Taming the Beast tests a young Horde hunter's skill with wild creatures. Thotar in Razor Hill guides the hunter through one last trial: taming a dangerous armored scorpid. Success brings the ability to tame, call, and dismiss a lasting companion.

Before a hunter can travel Kalimdor with an animal companion, they must prove they can command Durotar's harsh wildlife. Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill, sends trainees to subdue three kinds of creature with an enchanted taming rod. After facing dire boars and swift surf crawlers, they must now tame an armored scorpid, a venomous predator protected by heavy plates and known for resilience and speed.

Taming an armored scorpid tests a hunter's focus and control under attack, not their skill at killing. Thotar urges hunters to match the beast's quick, confident strikes. Once the hunter has charmed the scorpid, they return to Razor Hill and give the taming rod back to Thotar. That return completes the trial, and Thotar then teaches the wild's innate techniques, letting the hunter seek out and bind a permanent companion of their choosing.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The final creature you need to tame is one you should strive to emulate; the armored scorpid. It strikes quickly and confidently; to control a force such as this is your fate as a hunter.

When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will be yours to command. Under your control, your pet will gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to tame the scorpid?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have learned all I can teach you, friend. It is time for you to take what you have learned here and choose a pet of your own.
Here you are, friend. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
